Moment,Ⓒs.ⒹkzaRaH, muhUrtaH, nimi(me)zaH, palaM; ‘pleasant for the m(oment)’ ApAtaramaRIya; ‘but for a m(oment)’ kzaRamAtraM; ‘this very m(oment)’ asminneva kzaRe; ‘the m(oment) he is here’ atra tasminnAgatamAtre or Agata eva; ‘for the present m(oment)’ ApAtataH; ‘in a m(oment)’ kzaRAt, [] kzaRena, nimezamAtrAt, ekapadaM; ‘auspicious m(oment)’ SuBamuhUrtaH, lagnaM; See Instant also.
Ⓑ
 2 gurutvaM, mahattvaM, praBAvaH, gOravaM, mahiman m.; See Importance; ‘of little m(oment)’ aguruka, akiMcitkara (rI f.), laGvarTa, kzudra.
Ⓝ[Moment]ary,Ⓒa.ⒹkzaRika, kzaRasTAyin, acira, asTAyin; kzaRa, nimeza in comp.; ‘m(omentary) flash’ acirapraBA, kzaRadyuti f.; ‘m(omentary) obstacle’ kzaRaviGnaH.
Ⓝ[Moment]ous,Ⓒa.Ⓓguru, gurupraBAva, alaGu; See Important.
